name: Lunge with Sword Guard Hold
description: Deep lunge with both arms held in a saber-style guard — fencing/HEMA/kendo/iaido posture endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Assume a deep en-garde lunge position. Extend one arm in front (blade proxy), other hand near hip. Hold 30-45s. Switch sides.

name: Lying Leg Curl
description: Prone machine hamstring curl — isolated knee-flexion hamstring work.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down on the machine, ankles under the pad. Curl heels toward glutes, squeeze, lower with control.

name: Machine Chest-Supported Row
description: Plate-loaded or selectorized chest-supported row — fixed path, strict back work.
instructions_excerpt: Sit at the row machine with chest pad supporting torso. Pull handles to the ribs, squeeze, control the return.

name: Meadows Row
description: Single-arm landmine row using an overhand grip and staggered stance — heavy unilateral back work.
instructions_excerpt: Stand to the side of a landmine bar in a staggered stance. Hinge over, grip the end of the bar overhand, row the bar to the hip. Switch sides.

name: MTB Ready-Position Isometric
description: Attack / ready-position hold — the low-stance foundation of mountain biking technical handling.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in a bike-attack position: feet hip-width, knees bent, hips back, elbows out, eyes up. Hold 30-60s. Add small rocks side to side.

name: Multi-Pitch Belay-Stance Isometric
description: Long half-squat iso holding a loaded rope — belayer endurance for long pitches.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in a half squat against a wall. Hold a knotted rope or band with both hands, as if belaying. Hold 1-2 min. Keep glutes engaged and breath steady.

name: Neck Bridge (Wrestler's Bridge)
description: Isometric neck strengthening — essential for wrestlers and BJJ athletes, controversial for novices.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on back with feet flat, hands supporting near the head. Slowly raise hips and arch onto the top of the head, bearing some weight on the neck, some on hands. Start with hands carrying most load. Progress very gradually.

name: Neck Harness Extension (Four-Way)
description: Plate-loaded or harness-resisted neck strengthening in all four directions — essential for grapplers and strikers who absorb head contact.
instructions_excerpt: Using a neck harness or hand resistance, work flexion, extension, and both lateral flexions in turn. 8-12 slow reps each direction. Load is light — this is tendon and slow-twitch work, not a max lift.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
description: Pull-up with palms facing each other — shoulder-friendly vertical pull.
instructions_excerpt: Use a parallel-grip handle or rings. Hang neutral, pull until chin clears the bar, lower under control.

name: Neutral-Spine Seated Forward Hold
description: Neutral-spine forward lean hold with weighted pack — hang-glide/paraglide harness posture.
instructions_excerpt: Wear a weighted pack on the chest (10-20 lb). Sit with legs extended. Lean forward maintaining neutral spine, arms extended forward as if on harness bar. Hold 45-60s.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
description: Eccentric hamstring exercise — single most protective intervention against hamstring strains in running/soccer.
instructions_excerpt: Kneel on a pad with ankles anchored (partner or strap). Hinge at the knees, lowering torso toward the floor as slowly as possible. Catch with hands. Push back up with arms; repeat.

name: Oly Pulling-Position Hold
description: Mid-thigh pull position isometric — Olympic weightlifting pull-bar specific cue work.
instructions_excerpt: With an empty barbell, assume the pull position (bar at mid-thigh, shoulders slightly over bar, hips loaded). Hold 10-20 sec. 4-6 sets.

name: Oly Split-Jerk Position Drill
description: Split-position overhead hold — Olympic weightlifting split-jerk receiving.
instructions_excerpt: With an empty bar overhead, step into a split position (lead leg ~90, rear heel raised). Hold 5-10 sec. 4-6 per side.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
description: Cable overhead triceps extension with rope — long-head triceps emphasis in lengthened position.
instructions_excerpt: Face away from a cable column with rope attached at low or mid pulley. Rope behind head, elbows pointing forward. Extend arms overhead, return with control.

name: Overhead Carry (Light Pack Overhead)
description: Loaded overhead carry — shoulder stability + postural core for via-ferrata, aid, and alpine climbing via-scrambles.
instructions_excerpt: Press a light kettlebell or dumbbell overhead with one arm locked out. Walk 15-25 m, keeping ribs over pelvis and shoulder packed. Switch arms.

name: Overhead Plate Peasant Carry
description: Single-plate overhead carry — shoulder stability + core endurance under axial load.
instructions_excerpt: Press a single weight plate overhead with straight arms. Lock out the elbows, ribs stacked over pelvis. Walk 30-50 ft maintaining lockout. Set down, rest, repeat.

name: Overhead Sandbag Lockout Carry
description: Heavy sandbag pressed overhead and carried — strongman-style overhead stability under odd-object load.
instructions_excerpt: Press a sandbag overhead with both hands, arms locked. Walk 30-50 ft maintaining lockout. Drop, rest 2 min, repeat.

name: Paddle-Stroke Cable Row (Unilateral)
description: Cable single-arm paddle-stroke row — direct carryover to canoeing, SUP, rafting.
instructions_excerpt: Stand facing a cable machine, low attachment. Hinge slightly. Pull one arm back through a paddle-stroke arc, rotating the torso. Return, then repeat with other arm.

name: Pallof Press
description: Anti-rotation core — foundational for any rotational sport.
instructions_excerpt: Set a cable or band at chest height, anchored to one side. Stand perpendicular to the anchor. Hold the handle at the sternum with both hands. Press straight out to arms extended; hold 2s; return. Resist the rotational pull throughout.

name: Pause Squat
description: Back squat with a 2-3 second pause in the hole — kills the stretch reflex, builds bottom-end strength.
instructions_excerpt: Set up as for back squat. Descend to depth, pause 2-3 seconds without losing tightness, then drive up.

name: Pec Deck Fly
description: Pec deck machine — fixed-path chest fly with controlled stretch and squeeze.
instructions_excerpt: Sit at the pec-deck machine with forearms or hands on the pads. Bring the pads together by squeezing the chest. Control the return.

name: Pendlay Row
description: Strict barbell row from the floor each rep — explosive concentric, dead-stop reset.
instructions_excerpt: Hinge to torso parallel to floor. Bar starts on the floor each rep. Row explosively to the lower sternum, then return the bar fully to the floor.

name: Pike Compression Lift
description: Seated pike leg lift — compression strength for L-sits, V-sits, and pole inverts.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on the floor with legs extended in a pike. Hands flat next to hips. Lift straight legs as high as possible while keeping a pike position. Hold 1-2 seconds, lower.

name: Pike Push-Up
description: Bodyweight vertical push approximation — accessible overhead stimulus.
instructions_excerpt: From a downward-dog pike position with hips high, lower the top of your head toward a point between your hands. Press back up until arms are straight. Keep hips high throughout. Progress by elevating feet.

name: Pilates Hundred (Classic)
description: Pilates Hundred — classic core endurance exercise.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine, head and shoulders lifted, legs at 45 deg, arms hovering. Pump arms small and fast, breathing 5-in/5-out. 100 pumps total.

name: Pilates Roll-Up Control
description: Slow controlled roll-up from supine — classic pilates core control.
instructions_excerpt: Supine, arms overhead. Slowly roll up one vertebra at a time to seated, reach for toes, roll back down with control. 6-10 reps.

name: Pistol Grip Strength Hold
description: Isometric crush-grip hold — builds finger-strength for archery draw and firearm stability.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a heavy dumbbell in one hand, arm extended, at hip. Squeeze hard for 20-30s. Switch sides.

name: Planche Lean
description: Straight-arm anterior shoulder loading — the primary planche progression.
instructions_excerpt: In plank, lock elbows straight and protract scaps. Shift shoulders forward past the wrists as far as comfortable. Hold 10-20 seconds.

name: Plate Pinch Hold
description: Two-plate pinch grip hold — builds the pinch-grip endurance needed for gi lapels, wrist control, and clinch.
instructions_excerpt: Stack two smooth-sided plates (10-25 lb each). Pinch them together at the top with one hand, thumb on one side, fingers on the other. Stand tall and hold as long as possible up to 45 seconds. Alternate hands.

name: Pole-Fitness Climb Pull-Up
description: Pole-climb-specific vertical pull — direct pole-fitness strength.
instructions_excerpt: From floor, with two hands on a vertical pole, pull up into an inverted climb position, legs assisting briefly. 4-8 reps.

name: Pole-Hold Inversion Iso
description: Inverted pole hold — pole-fitness specific strength iso.
instructions_excerpt: Climb a pole into an inverted position. Hold inverted with core braced and grip secure for 10-20 sec. Lower controlled.

name: Pole/Bar Invert Tuck
description: Pole-fitness invert tuck progression — grip + compression to invert.
instructions_excerpt: Grip the pole/bar with both hands. Pull up while tucking knees to chest. Roll hips back to inverted position, legs tucked. Lower with control.

name: Pommel Horse Position Iso
description: Seated pommel-horse position iso — polo player's and dressage rider's seat endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on an exercise ball. Lift both feet off the floor and hold legs parallel to the floor for 20-45s. Maintain neutral spine.

name: Powerlifting Paused-Squat Pause
description: Back squat with 2-sec bottom pause — builds powerlifting-specific out-of-hole strength.
instructions_excerpt: Back squat to depth, pause 2 sec in the hole, drive up. 4-6 reps per set at 60-75% 1RM.

name: Preacher Curl
description: Biceps isolation with humerus fixed on preacher bench — removes body english and isolates the biceps stretch.
instructions_excerpt: Sit at a preacher bench, arms draped over the pad, elbows pinned. Hold an EZ-bar or dumbbells with a supinated grip. Curl to full flexion, then lower slowly to near full extension.

name: Prone Trap Raise (Y Raise)
description: Lower-trap strengthening — fixes the dropped-shoulder climber look.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down on an incline bench or floor with light dumbbells. Arms form a "Y" with thumbs pointing up and elbows slightly bent. Raise the arms up and slightly out by driving from the lower traps until arms are level with the torso. Lower slowly.

name: Pull-Up
description: Bodyweight pull-up, overhand grip — vertical pulling foundation.
instructions_excerpt: Hang from bar with overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders. Pull until chin clears the bar. Lower with control to a dead hang.

name: Push-Up
description: Primary antagonist pattern for climbers — pushing strength with scapular control.
instructions_excerpt: Start in a plank with hands shoulder-width, shoulders over wrists, body in a straight line from head to heels. Lower chest to an inch off the floor with elbows tracking ~45° from the torso. Press back to plank, finishing with scapular protraction (push the floor away).

name: Raft Guide Sweep Stroke
description: Wide bilateral rotational paddle sweep — raft guiding and whitewater position.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a dowel or paddle. From kneeling, sweep the paddle in a wide arc around the body from front to rear, 10-12 per side.

name: Rear Delt Pec Deck
description: Reverse pec-deck machine — fixed-path rear delt isolation.
instructions_excerpt: Sit facing the pec deck with handles set for reverse use. Drive elbows back, squeezing rear delts. Control the return.

name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat (Surf Stance)
description: Bulgarian split squat held in the surf stance — heavy quad/glute prep for the pop-up landing.
instructions_excerpt: Place rear foot on a bench, front foot 2-3 feet ahead. Lower into a deep split squat, then drive up. Hold DBs for load.

name: Relevé Calf Raise (Ballet)
description: Ballet-style relevé — full-range calf raise onto the balls of the feet, key for all dance forms.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall, heels together in first position (or parallel). Rise onto the balls of the feet as high as possible while staying tall. Lower with control.

name: Renegade Row
description: Plank + alternating dumbbell row — anti-rotation core plus pulling strength, the exact demand of paddleboarding.
instructions_excerpt: Start in a plank with hands on dumbbells, feet wide. Row one DB to the ribs while keeping hips square to the floor. Lower, switch sides. Avoid twisting the hips.

name: Reverse Crunch
description: Lying reverse crunch — lower-rectus emphasis via posterior pelvic tilt.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on back, hands at sides or under hips. Bring knees toward chest by curling the pelvis off the floor. Lower with control.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
description: Reverse hyperextension machine — glute, hamstring, erector work with traction-style spinal decompression.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down on the reverse hyper, hips at the edge. Swing legs from hang to horizontal by squeezing glutes. Control the descent.

name: Reverse Lunge (Barbell)
description: Barbell reverse lunge — knee-friendly unilateral squat pattern.
instructions_excerpt: Bar on back. Step one foot back into a lunge, dropping the back knee toward the floor. Drive through the front foot to return.

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
description: Kneeling quad-eccentric — builds the rectus femoris length-under-load that sprinters and soccer players need to avoid hip-flexor and quad strains.
instructions_excerpt: Kneel with knees hip-width apart, feet pointed. Keep the body rigid from knees to head. Slowly lean backward by extending the hips, reaching as far back as quads allow. Return to upright with control.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
description: Forearm extensor strengthening — counters chronic climbing grip load.
instructions_excerpt: Sit with forearm on a bench or thigh, palm down, hand hanging off the edge. Hold a light dumbbell with a relaxed grip. Curl the wrist upward extending the hand toward the ceiling. Lower slowly. Keep the forearm planted.

name: Rider Wall Sit with Ball Squeeze
description: Isometric wall sit with a ball between the knees — mimics the position and inner-thigh demand of the saddle.
instructions_excerpt: Sit against a wall at 90° knees and 90° hips. Place a ball between the knees and squeeze throughout. Hold for 30-60 seconds. Breathe and maintain posture.

name: Ring Dip (False Grip Optional)
description: Gymnastics-ring dip — essential pushing strength for muscle-up and ring work.
instructions_excerpt: Hang at the top of rings with straight arms, rings turned out. Lower the body until shoulders are just below the rings. Press back up with control.

name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
description: Hip-hinge with minimal knee bend — hamstring and posterior chain foundation.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a barbell at the hips, feet hip-width. Soften knees slightly (10-15° bend). Hinge at the hips by pushing the hips back, keeping the bar close to the legs and the spine neutral. Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch (usually mid-shin). Drive hips forward to stand.

name: Rope Pushdown
description: Cable rope triceps pushdown with end-range split — lateral-head triceps emphasis.
instructions_excerpt: Use a rope attachment on a high cable. Push down, splitting the rope outward at the bottom. Squeeze triceps, return with control.

name: Russian Twist
description: Seated rotational twist — oblique work with optional weight.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on the floor, knees bent, lean torso back to ~45°. Hold weight at chest (or bodyweight). Rotate torso side to side, touching weight toward each hip.

name: Safety-Bar Squat
description: Back squat with SSB — reduces shoulder ROM demand while loading the posterior chain heavily. Standard powerlifting accessory.
instructions_excerpt: Unrack the safety bar across the upper back with hands on the padded handles. Brace and squat to depth, driving elbows forward to prevent a chest dump. Stand tall.

name: Sandbag Bear Hug Carry
description: Loaded bear hug carry — awkward-object conditioning that mirrors controlling a grip in clinch, bear hug, or top position.
instructions_excerpt: Pick up a sandbag in a bear hug at chest height. Walk 30-50 feet maintaining posture. Reset and repeat for time or distance.

name: Sandbag Shoulder Carry
description: Heavy sandbag loaded on one shoulder — asymmetric loaded carry mimicking packing out game.
instructions_excerpt: Hoist a heavy sandbag onto one shoulder. Walk 40-60 ft maintaining tall posture. Switch shoulders at the halfway point or on the next carry.

name: Sandbag Stone-to-Shoulder
description: Sandbag / stone lifted from floor to shoulder — strongman / highland games specific.
instructions_excerpt: Lift a heavy sandbag from the floor. Drag to chest, transition to one shoulder. Walk 5-10m. Drop. 4-6 reps alternating shoulders.

name: Scapular Retraction Hold
description: Isometric scapular retraction hold — trains the endurance of the archer's back posture.
instructions_excerpt: Either prone on a bench or standing with a band pulled apart at chest height. Pull the shoulder blades down and together, hold for 10-15 seconds. Release partially, repeat.

name: Seal Row
description: Prone barbell or dumbbell row with chest supported on a raised bench — strict back work, no torso swing.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down on an elevated bench with bar/dumbbells hanging below. Row to the bench, squeeze, control the return. No leg or torso English.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Horizontal pull with constant tension — climber-friendly daily-driver.
instructions_excerpt: Sit with feet braced, knees slightly bent, and grip a close-grip or neutral handle on a cable machine. Start with arms extended, lats engaged. Pull the handle to the lower sternum, driving elbows back; squeeze the shoulder blades. Return under control.

name: Seated Calf Raise
description: Seated machine calf raise — soleus-biased isolation.
instructions_excerpt: Sit in the machine, knees under pads, balls of feet on the platform. Press up onto the toes, squeeze, lower under stretch.

name: Seated Dumbbell Press
description: Seated dumbbell overhead press — vertical push with independent arms.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on a bench with back support (or upright). Press dumbbells from shoulder level overhead. Lower under control, dumbbells stop near the ears.

name: Seated Leg Curl
description: Seated machine hamstring curl — hip-flexed knee flexion, distal hamstring bias.
instructions_excerpt: Sit in machine with thigh pad locking legs in place. Curl heels under, squeeze, return with control.

name: Seated Loaded Reach
description: Seated KB/DB-loaded forward reach — sailing postural endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Seated on a bench with a dumbbell. Extend both arms forward holding the weight at shoulder height. Hold 20-30s. Breathe. Lower.

name: Shotgun Mount Iso
description: Held mount of a shotgun in the shoulder pocket — endurance for clay shooters.
instructions_excerpt: Mount an unloaded shotgun (or dowel/PVC as a proxy) to the shoulder pocket. Hold the firing position for 30-60s. Switch cheeks after a set.

name: Side Plank
description: Anti-lateral-flexion core — critical for runners and rotational athletes.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on side with elbow under shoulder, legs stacked. Lift hips so body forms a straight line from feet to head. Hold. Breathe.

name: Single-Arm Cable Paddle Pull
description: Standing single-arm cable row that mimics the catch-and-pull of a paddle stroke — primary dryland strength builder for paddlers.
instructions_excerpt: Stand square to a mid-height cable with a single handle. From a staggered stance, reach the handle forward (catch), then pull past the hip with a rotating torso, driving the elbow back. Control the return. 8-12 reps per side.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Row
description: Single-arm row with a landmine — anti-rotation loaded pull, the team-sport core-and-back combo.
instructions_excerpt: Set a barbell in a landmine. Straddle the sleeve facing away. Hinge and grip the sleeve in one hand. Row the barbell up while resisting torso rotation. Lower under control.

name: Single-Arm Push-Up on Stability Ball
description: Unstable unilateral pressing — mimics paddle-and-stand board-sport transitions.
instructions_excerpt: In push-up stance with one hand on a stability ball, other on the floor. Perform a push-up while stabilizing the ball. 6-8 per side.

name: Single-Arm Row + Anti-Rotation Press
description: Alternating single-arm row with anti-rotation Pallof hold — corrects rider asymmetry (stronger rein-hand side).
instructions_excerpt: In a split stance with a cable or band at chest height, press one hand out while rowing the opposite hand to the ribs. Hold the press briefly, switch. Maintain a tight trunk throughout.
